name: Crowdfunding Fulfillment Operations
promise: Operate one settled crowdfunding campaign to an honest obligation-level completion or blocked-state receipt.
summary: A privacy-safe obligation ledger, bounded operating cycles, only the physical, digital, regional, address, exception, and communication modules that apply, and independently reconciled completion evidence.
useWhen: A crowdfunding funding run is funded and settled with real obligations.
The team needs a durable control loop for production, delivery, exceptions, and backer commitments.
notFor: A campaign that is only prepared, live, unfunded, cancelled, or unsettled.
A universal 95%-shipped target when obligations are digital, mixed, refunded, or otherwise non-shipping.
Creating missing manufacturing or safety evidence inside fulfillment operations.

workstreams.name: Obligation and authority baseline
workstreams.brief: Import only necessary settled obligations, pseudonymize records, define completion states, authorities, dependencies, budgets, and stop conditions.

workstreams.name: Bounded fulfillment operation
workstreams.brief: Execute the smallest approved cycle across active modules; preserve per-obligation evidence, exceptions, reversals, and waiting states.

workstreams.name: Independent obligation reconciliation
workstreams.brief: Reconcile every in-scope obligation without hiding failed delivery, refunds, replacements, disputes, exclusions, or unresolved blockers.

outputs: Approved fulfillment authority and dependency baseline
Applicable module evidence and exception ledger
guardrails: Do not purchase, manufacture, access addresses, message backers, ship, refund, replace, or mutate provider state without exact approval and authority.
Do not expose backer identity, contact, address, payment, tax, customs, or support data in general artifacts.
Do not claim fulfillment from labels, tracking creation, bulk percentages, or shipped state alone; preserve delivered, failed, returned, refunded, replaced, disputed, and unknown states.
Do not hide an unready production dependency inside operations; stop and identify the missing outcome or authority.
Safe default for each bounded cycle: Do not purchase, manufacture, ship, message, refund, or expose backer data without exact authority.
Complete means every in-scope obligation has a directly evidenced terminal state; operating and blocked are honest durable outcomes, not failures to be hidden.
verification: Reconcile the settled funding receipt to the obligation ledger.
Verify each terminal obligation state from direct evidence and preserve the denominator.
Challenge privacy, regional, exception, refund, replacement, and communication controls for active modules.
Write a complete, operating, blocked, repair-required, or no-go receipt without a universal shipment threshold.
Confirm the prerequisite baseline before beginning work: Crowdfunding Funding Run finished funded-settled for the exact campaign.
Reconcile each bounded cycle: Reconcile obligations, execution evidence, exceptions, communications, and stop conditions.
Reconcile the funded-settled receipt into a minimized obligation ledger.
Define terminal states per obligation type rather than imposing one shipment percentage.
Execute only approved actions in immutable dated cycles and preserve exceptions.
Use independent reconciliation before declaring any obligation or campaign complete.

expectations.statement: The ledger accounts for every settled campaign obligation without duplication or silent exclusion.
Every claimed terminal state has direct obligation-level evidence.
External fulfillment actions stayed within approved authority.
Physical rewards follow verified production, quality, inventory, and delivery evidence. Applicable when: At least one settled obligation requires a physical item.
Digital rewards are delivered, accessible, and supportable for the named obligations. Applicable when: At least one settled obligation requires a digital deliverable or entitlement.

Active regions have explicit freight, customs, tax, restriction, and failure handling. Applicable when: Physical obligations cross regions with material freight, customs, tax, or restriction exposure.
Address data is minimized, authorized, protected, and deleted or retained by policy. Applicable when: Fulfillment requires access to backer addresses or related delivery data.

Replacements, refunds, returns, disputes, and failed delivery remain explicit and reconciled. Applicable when: The campaign has or promises replacement, refund, return, dispute, or failed-delivery handling.

Approved recurring communications are factual, consistent, and preserve responses and corrections. Applicable when: The approved fulfillment plan includes recurring backer updates or exception messages.
Crowdfunding Funding Run finished funded-settled for the exact campaign.

expectations.statement: Crowdfunding fulfillment operations produces enough evidence for an independent readiness decision. The possible decisions are complete, operating, blocked, repair-required, no-go. Complete means every in-scope obligation has a directly evidenced terminal state; operating and blocked are honest durable outcomes, not failures to be hidden.
failureModes: missing evidence for the declared outcome
